## History

Jane Ann is the cousin of Mrs. Amelia [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Skinner](../character/skinner.md). She married a wealthy man whom she did not love. As a result of this marriage, she endures a miserable life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P1](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0001), [v3 ch.Romance P2](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0002), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P6](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0006), [v3 ch.Romance P7](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0007), [v3 ch.Romance P8](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0008), +6 more_
